name: NYU Depth Dataset V2: Indoor RGB-D Segmentation and Support Inference
description: The NYU Depth Dataset V2 is a landmark RGB-D indoor scene understanding dataset recorded across 464 diverse indoor scenes using Microsoft Kinect cameras. It contains 1,449 densely labeled pairs of aligned RGB and depth images with detailed object segmentations and structural surface support relations, alongside a comprehensive raw repository of 407,024 video frames widely adopted for monocular depth estimation and 3D semantic perception.
